items.title: Munoz rescues point for Liverpool as Iraola's wait for a win goes on
items.description: Victor Munoz thumped in a deflected leveller to rescue a point for Liverpool in a 2-2 draw with Nottingham Forest.

items.title: Iraola urges 'passive' Liverpool to learn quickly after Forest draw
items.description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola says his side need to "learn lessons" after they twice come from behind to draw 2-2 with Nottingham Forest at Anfield.

items.title: 'Proud' but 'disappointed' - Glasner's mixed emotions after Liverpool draw
items.description: Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner says he was "proud" of his side's performance at Anfield as they draw 2-2 with Liverpool in the Premier League, and believes they could have won.

items.title: Wolves ease to victory against Stoke
items.description: Wolves came from behind to beat Stoke 4-1 and continue their unbeaten start in the Sky Bet Championship.

items.title: Lankshear scores twice as Boro beat West Brom
items.description: Will Lankshear made it six goals in five games following his summer move from Tottenham as Middlesbrough's strong start to the season continued with a 3-1 home win over West Brom.

items.title: Swansea cruise to away win at struggling Derby
items.description: Swansea remained unbeaten in this season's Championship after goals from Joseph Opoku, Eom Ji-sung and Ronald secured a convincing 3-0 win at Derby.
